name: Jash Engineering Limited
summary: Jash Engineering Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells various engineering products for general engineering, water and wastewater, power plant, and bulk solids handling industries in India and internationally. The company offers water control gates, such as slide/penstock, open channel, weir, and flap gates, as well as stop logs; heavy fabricated gates, including bulkhead, rollers, crest, butterfly, radial/tainter, bonneted, tilting weir, swing, and mitre gates; and screening equipment comprising manual bar, trash rack with flat bars, trash rack with wire mesh, J-type trash rack, suspended grab trash rake, multi-rake bar, step, pre-scalators, travelling band, drum, and static screens.
